definitions.explanation: The joints of the body, especially when referring to pain or stiffness felt throughout the body.

definitions.gloss: various points; here and there; throughout
definitions.explanation: Various parts or moments in something, such as points in a speech, story, or behavior.

examples.japanese: {風邪|かぜ}を{引|ひ}いて{体|からだ}の{節々|ふしぶし}が{痛|いた}む。
examples.english: I caught a cold and my joints ache all over.

examples.japanese: {年|とし}を{取|と}ると、{節々|ふしぶし}がきしむようになる。
examples.english: As you get older, your joints start to creak.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{話|はなし}の{節々|ふしぶし}に{不満|ふまん}がにじんでいた。
examples.english: Dissatisfaction showed through at various points in his story.

examples.japanese: {態度|たいど}の{節々|ふしぶし}に{優|やさ}しさが{感|かん}じられる。
examples.english: Kindness can be felt throughout her demeanor.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}の{言葉|ことば}の{節々|ふしぶし}から、{本音|ほんね}が{見|み}え{隠|かく}れしていた。
examples.english: Her true feelings kept peeking through at various points in her words.

notes:
USAGE:
A reduplication of {節|ふし} (joint; point). Sense 1 is very common in health-related contexts, particularly when describing flu symptoms or age-related aches. Sense 2 is used in literary or reflective contexts to describe recurring qualities noticed throughout something.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {節々|ふしぶし}が{痛|いた}い (joints ache)
- {節々|ふしぶし}が{痛|いた}む (joints hurt)
- {話|はなし}の{節々|ふしぶし}に (at various points in the story)
- {態度|たいど}の{節々|ふしぶし}に (throughout one's attitude)
